note.question: How can the role of problem specification in crowdsourcing contests for design problems be analyzed using a theoretical and empirical analysis?
note.overview: This paper studies the role of seekers’ problem specification in crowdsourcing contests for design problems. Platforms hosting design contests offer detailed guidance for seekers to specify their problems when launching a contest. Yet problem specification in such crowdsourcing contests is something the theoretical and empirical literature has largely overlooked.
